intro_lore:
=================================================

You wake up with a pounding headache in a cold, dim room.
The air is stale, thick with the smell of rust and decay.

Your memory is a blur, but the flashing red emergency lights
and the biohazard warnings tell you one thing:
This underground facility is in lockdown, and it's not safe here.

You must find the access keys, unlock the Main Gate,
and escape to the surface before the backup power dies completely...

=================================================
help_menu:
--- AVAILABLE COMMANDS ---
- go [direction] (north, south, east, west)
- look / look at [object] (examine your surroundings)
- take [item] (pick up an item)
- inventory (check your bag)
- open [object] with [item] (use an item on something)
- talk Interact with characters you meet on your journey. 
- save / load (save or resume your progress)
- quit (exit game)
--------------------------
